title: JIT: A header-only, cross-platform JIT compiler library in C
description: JIT is a cross-platform Just-In-Time compiler library in C that enhances software performance by allowing code to be compiled at runtime. Supporting multiple architectures such as x86 and ARM, JIT is designed for ease of use, featuring a straightforward API and no external dependencies. With capabilities like automatic buffer growth and a comprehensive instruction set, JIT is poised to become a vital tool for developers aiming to optimize their applications.
